description: Approved Architecture Decision Records. An ADR is either an exception record (lists standards in authorises_exception_to) or a plain decision record (omits authorises_exception_to). Exception ADRs authorise a design choice that would otherwise violate a standard marked adr_overridable: true; cite the ADR ID inline where the authorised pattern appears and in any pr-reviewer finding to downgrade the severity to Informational. Decision-only ADRs record context, rationale, and consequences for a significant architectural choice that contradicts no standard; they are available as context but do not downgrade any finding.
